messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "increase by 850 mg every 2 weeks"
set: ["increase by 850 mg every 2 weeks", "increase dosage by 25 mg every 3 days", "40 mg every 12 weeks", "increase by 500 mg increments weekly", "increase total daily dose by 50 mg every 3 days as tolerated", "5 mg every 2 to 3 days", "increase by 2.5 mg to 5 mg per day at 1 to 2 week intervals", "2 to 3 weeks", "increase to 20 mg/day after 2 weeks for adolescents and higher-weight children", "can be increased by 100 mg every 5 days if needed", "increase dosage to 2 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 1 mg if additional glycemic control is needed", "increase dosage to 0.5 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 0.25 mg", "up to 2 to 3 weeks", "increase in 2.5 mg increments after at least 4 weeks on current dose for Type 2 Diabetes", "increase to 5 mg subcutaneously once a week after 4 weeks", "dose not increased more than once every 4 weeks"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
